name: Roland RE-201 Space Echo (S/N 587250 and later: OP-13 / OP-14B / FL-7, PS-15D)
description: Roland RE-201 from the instrument jack to the output jack, per the July 1978 service notes. Instrument input (8.2k || 1 nF, VR3) and SW3 Echo/Normal. Echo path: R3 47k into the OP-13 mic amplifier (Q1 / Q12 / Q2, 120k overall feedback), node 11 (J), R35 27k into the record sum (node 12) where the Intensity pot VR5 returns the playback, Q3 recording pre-amp, VR11 recording level, Q4 recording amp with the C35 .068 emitter pre-emphasis, C36 / R48 6.8k constant-current feed and the L21 14 mH || 470 pF bias trap into the record head of the tape block (bias and erase oscillator not simulated). Three playback heads switched by the 12-position mode selector (SW1b-d) to the OP-14B playback preamp Q5 / Q13 / Q6 whose C59 .0068 feedback is the playback integration EQ; node 18 feeds the Echo pot VR6 and, through VR12 / R73 / C61, the Intensity pot. Echo: Q7 follower and the active Baxandall Bass / Treble around Q8; R86 22k into the Q9 output buffer. Direct: J4's switch passes the mic-amp output (node 11) through C6 / R10; Q11 amplifies the Normal instrument signal and the reverb return; both sum with the echo at Q9's base; FL-7 filter and the H/M/L output divider. Reverb: node 11 through R50 / R51 into IC1 TA-7200P (42 dB, R54 / R53), R59 10 Ohm into the Z-3F 3-spring tank, Q10 recovery, VR10, SW1a (modes 5-12), R11 and VR9. Supply: power transformer RED winding, bridge, R111 82 Ohm, C110 1000 uF, Q21 capacitance-multiplier pass transistor and R109 180 Ohm to the 17 V rail (pin 40), R34 / R72 820 Ohm to the mic and playback rails.

sources.title: Roland RE-201/101 Echo Chamber Service Notes, 2nd edition (30 Jul 1978): specifications, OP-13/OP-14B/FL-7 circuit diagram with DC voltages and signal levels, mode selector vs activated playback head table, PS-15D circuit diagram, electrical adjustment (trap coil, bias/recording current, intensity), reference data (bias 50-60 V rms across the erase head, tape speed 12-40 cm/s approx, treble +10 dB at 5 kHz, bass +10 dB at 100 Hz), parts list
Universal Audio, Roland RE-201 Space Echo plug-in manual: head delay ranges 69-177 / 131-337 / 189-489 ms over Repeat Rate (describes the emulation)
J. Chowdhury, 'Real-time physical modelling for analog tape machines', DAFx-19 (tape Ms, a, alpha; head-loss formulas)
Kaloinen, MSc thesis (Aalto), tape-delay modelling, citing DAFX 2nd ed. ch. 12: Space Echo flutter peaks 3.5 Hz (pinch wheel) and 22 Hz (capstan), head 1 measured 60-160 ms
freestompboxes.org RE-201 thread (search excerpt): discrete 2SC1000GR / 2SA493GR electronics
Amplified Parts, Accutronics 8AB2D1A (usual RE-201 replacement tank): short 3-spring, medium decay, 10 Ohm in / 2575 Ohm out

io.note: Instrument jack in; output at the H tap (-15 dBm = 0.14 V rms nominal for -24 dBm in). Calibration left to the engine owner

2SC1000GR.note: unverified: Toshiba 2SC1000-GR (hFE 200-400 GR rank); no vendor SPICE card found: IS/BR/VAF generic small-signal. Transistor type per freestompboxes RE-201 notes (2SC1000GR / 2SA493GR)

2SA493GR.note: unverified: Toshiba 2SA493-GR (PS-15D parts list: '2SA733 P or 2SA493 GR'); generic parameters

2SD571.note: unverified: NEC 2SD571 L (PS-15D parts list); generic medium-power parameters

TA7200P.note: unverified: Toshiba TA-7200P audio power-amp IC: no data sheet found; macro values assumed

RE201_SM.note: Library RE201 with v0 = 0.40 m/s: the service notes give 'Tape Speed 12 cm - 40 cm/sec (approx)'. Delays 69/131/189 ms and range 2.57 from the UA RE-201 manual (the service-note speed range 40/12 = 3.3 disagrees: unverified which is right). Ms/a/alpha Chowdhury DAFx-19. gain 2e-06 calibrated 2026-11-12 to the service notes' own procedure (2-3 / 2-4, p.22-23): at one input level and VR11 = 0.5 the echo-only output (Echo Volume max, Intensity min, FROM PA blanked) is +3 dB over the direct output (-12 vs -15 dBm). Measured 1 kHz, 49 mV, head 1: echo 125 mV vs direct 86 mV (+3.2 dB); node 17 4.2 mV and Q13 collector 373 mV at a Q4 emitter of 176 mV (p.6 level chart: 5 mV / 550 mV at 240 mV). The shipped 5e-07 put the echo 12 dB under that (inaudible at the default patch). unverified: drive, head R/L, gap/spacing/thickness, wow/flutter amplitudes, servo

1N4001_PAIR.note: Two series 1N4001 bridge legs (MI-152 + return leg) collapsed to eliminate floating midpoint between zero-capacitance reverse-biased diodes: N = 2*1.984, RS = 2*0.03389

parts.label: IC1 TA-7200P reverb drive amplifier
parts.note: Internal power-amp IC as a macro op-amp: + = pin 10, - = pin 8, out = pin 2. Supply: pin 4 -> OP-14B terminal 38 -> PS-15D pin 39, the separate 11 V GRY-winding rail (b11), not the 17 V rail (service notes p.5 circuit diagram: terminal 38 wiring and the '11V' label at pin 39; p.9 PS-15D diagram: OP-14B 38 -> 39 <- R113/C111 <- R114/C112 <- D12/D15 bridge <- GRY). On the 17 V rail the 42 dB driver's tank current (up to ~0.2 A) collapsed b17 behind R109 180 Ohm (12-13 V with a nominal input). C44 .001 (pins 3/4), C46 100 pF (pin 5), C45 47 uF bootstrap (pin 6) and C43 47 uF ripple filter (pin 7, 4 V) are internal-compensation parts of the IC and are folded into the macro
